from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Invoice, LineItem
from .money import ZERO, round_money, to_money


def line_total(line: LineItem) -> Decimal:
    return round_money(to_money(line.unit_price) * line.quantity)


def invoice_total(invoice: Invoice) -> Decimal:
    return round_money(sum((line_total(line) for line in invoice.lines), ZERO))


def issue_invoice(invoice: Invoice, at: datetime) -> Invoice:
    if invoice.status != "draft":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")
    if not invoice.lines:
        raise BillingError("empty_invoice", invoice.id)
    invoice.issued_at = ensure_utc(at)
    invoice.status = "issued"
    audit.record("invoice_issued", invoice_id=invoice.id, total=invoice_total(invoice))
    return invoice

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)

# full refund + status
p = Payment("p1","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
r = refund(p, Decimal("100.00"), T0)
assert r is p and p.status=="refunded" and p.refunded_amount==Decimal("100.00")
assert audit.events("payment_refunded")[0]["amount"] == 100.0
assert isinstance(audit.events("payment_refunded")[0]["amount"], float)

# idempotency: same key returns same record, no double apply
p2 = Payment("p2","i2",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
a = refund(p2, Decimal("40.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
b = refund(p2, Decimal("40.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
assert a is b and p2.refunded_amount==Decimal("40.00")
assert len(audit.events("payment_refunded"))==2

# approval required above 500
p3 = Payment("p3","i3",Decimal("1000.00"),status="captured")
try:
    refund(p3, Decimal("600.00"), T0)
    assert False
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code=="approval_required"
refund(p3, Decimal("600.00"), T0, approved_by="mgr")
assert p3.refunded_amount==Decimal("600.00")

# at/below 500 no approval
p4 = Payment("p4","i4",Decimal("1000.00"),status="captured")
refund(p4, Decimal("500.00"), T0)

# over-refund
p5 = Payment("p5","i5",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
